plan.title: Asset PR to Split Auction Award and PO

steps.note: Enable split awarding required by the case.
Enable eRFX project creation.
Allow vendors to be added during event creation.
Provide the mandatory event title.
Commit the 30-minute bidding schedule; the exact evaluation duration is not expressible by this step.
Invite exactly two QA vendors for the two required bids.
Publish the auction event.
Verify publication reached a real project page.
Submit Vendor A's portal bid at 100.
Verify the first vendor bid was accepted.
Submit the second vendor's portal bid at 90.
Verify the second vendor bid was accepted.
Wait for bidding to end before ranking and awarding.
Open the buyer comparison grid after bidding closes.
Verify the lower bid is ranked first across the vendor responses.
Enter the awarding flow.
Allocate six units to the second bidding vendor, whose bid is the lower-ranked amount.
Allocate the remaining four units to the first bidding vendor.
Verify both vendors and the split total of 6×90 plus 4×100.
Create the proposal from the completed split allocation.
Verify navigation to the proposal screen.
Submit the split award proposal.
Verify that the award proposal was created and submitted.
Approve the submitted award with the required remark when the run's buyer is the pending approver.
Complete approval and create one purchase order per awarded vendor.
Verify the resulting purchase orders contain two awarded PO lines in total.
Return to the events list to inspect the event's history placement.
Open the Events History tab.
Verify the created event appears in history.
